notes.title: FREE DEMO NOW AVAILABLE FOR PLAY!
notes.content:
Hey guys! We have joined the Steam Next Fest for February of 2022, which means that as of today, a free demo is available to play and enjoy. Thank you all for your patience, and we have been working consistently to make updates on the demo, but if you run into any issues or just wanna talk about it, feel free to message me via Discord! I am very giddy about this and I can't wait for you all to get a taste of this insanity. 

Also, we have fixed some of the recent bugs make sure you have the latest version of the game before filing a report and we apologize for any bugs you may have experienced with the first build. We will keep working on any issues and improve the demo. Thanks!

Love,

- Bella and Jerome :))

tags.feature: a free demo is available to play and enjoy

tags.bug: we have fixed some of the recent bugs
